paragraphs.zh: Abbildungsblatt ohne Fließtext. Das Blatt trägt genau eine Grafik, quer (um 90 Grad gedreht) auf die Hochformatseite gesetzt, und darunter links die fett gedruckte Beschriftung "Fig. 3a". Aufgetragen ist ein Spektrum als durchgehende schwarze Linie in einem rechteckigen Rahmen. Die Abszisse ist beschriftet "Wellenzahl cm-1"; die gedruckten Teilstriche lauten 3500, 3000, 2500, 2000, 1500, 1000 und laufen von links nach rechts fallend, der Rahmen reicht über die beschrifteten Teilstriche hinaus von etwa 4000 bis etwa 550 cm-1 (Randwerte geschätzt, nicht gedruckt). Die Ordinate trägt keinen Titel und keine Einheit; ihre sieben etwa gleich weit stehenden Teilstriche sind von unten nach oben beschriftet 0.0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.2, 0.3, 0.3, 0.4 (Dezimalpunkt, nicht Komma; die Wiederholungen stehen so auf der Seite). Die Banden weisen nach oben, die Grundlinie liegt unten bei etwa 0.0 bis 0.04; es ist also kein nach unten laufendes Transmissionsspektrum, sondern eine nach oben laufende Absorptionsdarstellung. Von etwa 4000 bis etwa 1700 cm-1 ist die Kurve nahezu flach, mit einer schwachen Bandengruppe um etwa 3000 bis 2900 cm-1 und einer verrauschten Stelle mit einem scharfen Ausschlag bis auf die Nulllinie bei etwa 2150 bis 2100 cm-1. Unterhalb von etwa 1700 cm-1 folgt ein dichter Bandenbereich mit rund 25 bis 30 unterscheidbaren Banden. Die höchsten Banden liegen ungefähr bei 1130 und 1090 cm-1 (nahe dem obersten Teilstrich), weitere kräftige Banden ungefähr bei 1670, 1390, 1250, 930 und 740 cm-1. Alle diese Lagen sind vom Diagramm abgeschätzt und ausdrücklich ungenau; die genauen Werte stehen in Tabelle 2 des Beschreibungsteils.
paragraphs.en: Figure sheet, no running text. The sheet carries exactly one plot, set landscape (rotated 90 degrees) on the portrait page, with the bold label "Fig. 3a" printed below it at the left. What is plotted is a spectrum, a single continuous black trace inside a rectangular frame. The x axis is labelled "Wellenzahl cm-1" (wavenumber cm-1); the printed ticks are 3500, 3000, 2500, 2000, 1500, 1000, decreasing left to right, and the frame runs past the labelled ticks from roughly 4000 down to roughly 550 cm-1 (those end values are estimated from the frame, they are not printed). The y axis carries no title and no unit; its seven roughly evenly spaced ticks are labelled, bottom to top, 0.0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.2, 0.3, 0.3, 0.4 (decimal point, not comma; the repeated labels are exactly as printed). Bands point UPWARD from a baseline near 0.0 to 0.04 at the bottom, so this is not a downward-running transmission trace but an upward-running absorption-style trace. From about 4000 down to about 1700 cm-1 the curve is nearly flat, with a weak group of bands around 3000 to 2900 cm-1 and a noisy stretch with one sharp excursion down to the zero line around 2150 to 2100 cm-1. Below about 1700 cm-1 comes a dense fingerprint region with roughly 25 to 30 distinguishable bands. The tallest bands sit at approximately 1130 and 1090 cm-1 (close to the top tick), with further strong bands at approximately 1670, 1390, 1250, 930 and 740 cm-1. Every one of those positions is estimated off the plot and is explicitly approximate; the exact values are printed in Tabelle 2 of the description.
paragraphs.notes: MARKER: the marker is the figure label exactly as printed on the sheet, "Fig. 3a". The sheet prints no [00NN] paragraph marker and no prose. WHICH ABBILDUNG: [0018] lists the six figures as Abbildung 1, 1a, 2, 2a, 3 and 3a, so the printed "Fig. 3a" identifies this sheet as Abbildung 3a, the infrared spectrum of crystal modification III. This is read off the sheet itself, not inferred from its position in the run of figure sheets. SUPPORTING EVIDENCE that it is the infrared and not the Raman member of the pair: the x axis spans about 4000 to 550 cm-1, the standard mid-infrared range, rather than a Raman shift range; the ordinate runs 0.0 to about 0.4, the magnitude of an absorbance scale, not an arbitrary intensity scale; the C-H stretch region near 3000 cm-1 is weak while the fingerprint region is very strong, which is the infrared intensity pattern; and there is a noisy excursion to zero near 2150 to 2100 cm-1 of the kind an infrared instrument produces and a Raman instrument does not. APPROXIMATION: peak positions above are deliberately coarse. Do not treat them as data. Tabelle 2 carries the printed values.

discrepancies.what: The sheet labels the figure with the English abbreviation while the German description calls the same thing an Abbildung.
discrepancies.text_says: [0018] of the description names the six figures Abbildung 1, Abbildung 1a, Abbildung 2, Abbildung 2a, Abbildung 3 and Abbildung 3a. The word Abbildung is not printed on this sheet.

notes: This sheet carries a spectrum and no chemical structure at all, so "drawings": [] is a FINDING, not an omission. There is nothing on this page that the structures schema could hold: no ring system, no substituent, no arrow, no SMILES. The whole patent contains exactly one drawn structure and it is the tembotrione formula in [0002] on page 2. TEXT LAYER: the page carries exactly 19 characters, the running header "EP 2 045 236 A1" and the page number "20", and /tmp/ep2045/page20.txt confirms that and nothing else. Everything else on the sheet, the figure label "Fig. 3a", the axis label "Wellenzahl cm-1" and every tick number, is part of the image and was read off the pixels. ORIENTATION: the plot is printed rotated 90 degrees; it was rotated clockwise for reading, which puts the header down the right-hand edge and the page number down the left. Y AXIS ODDITY: the seven ordinate labels read 0.0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.2, 0.3, 0.3, 0.4 from the bottom up, at ticks that are evenly spaced to within a couple of pixels. That sequence is not consistent with any single uniform step under either rounding or truncation to one decimal, so the underlying tick values cannot be recovered from what is printed. The labels are recorded verbatim and not reconstructed. No y axis title or unit is printed anywhere on the sheet, so the quantity is unlabelled; the trace running upward from a near-zero baseline over a 0 to 0.4 range is consistent with absorbance, but the sheet does not say so and this is not asserted. DOC_PART: the prompt enum offers only front_page, claims and description and has no value for a drawings sheet, so "drawings" is used here. MODEL: this V pass was produced by Claude Opus 5 (model id claude-opus-5[1m]) reading the rendered page image.
doc_part_note: doc_part normalised to 'drawings' by the run owner after the V pass. The prompt's enum is front_page|claims|description and has no value for a figure sheet, so the six sheet agents split three and three between 'description' and 'drawings' on identical pages. Nothing validates this field (build_enriched.py:157 and make_visual_evidence.py:980 pass it through as a label), so the honest value is kept and made consistent rather than forced back into an enum that cannot express it. The agents' own reasoning is preserved in each file's notes.
